mapper.select: select seal_id, legal_entity_id, seal_code, seal_name, seal_type, is_default, seal_image_url, seal_image_hash, valid_from, valid_to, status, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from oa_company_seal_config where status = '0' order by seal_id desc limit 1

select s.seal_id, s.legal_entity_id, le.legal_entity_name, s.seal_code, s.seal_name, s.seal_type, s.is_default, s.seal_image_url, s.seal_image_hash, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from oa_company_seal_config s left join sys_legal_entity le on le.legal_entity_id = s.legal_entity_id where s.seal_id = #{sealId}

select s.seal_id, s.legal_entity_id, le.legal_entity_name, s.seal_code, s.seal_name, s.seal_type, s.is_default, s.seal_image_url, s.seal_image_hash, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.status, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark from oa_company_seal_config s inner join sys_legal_entity le on le.legal_entity_id = s.legal_entity_id where s.legal_entity_id = #{legalEntityId} and s.status = '0' and s.is_default = 'Y' and (s.valid_from is null or s.valid_from <= sysdate()) and (s.valid_to is null or s.valid_to >= sysdate()) order by s.seal_id asc limit 1
